title: Culture Bowl
obtain: Craft a flower pot, Spore Culture and wheat seed into one Bowl; place it on Living Substrate.
use: Use a stick to cycle recipes. Insert ingredients one at a time and water by bucket. Use an empty hand to start; sneak-use an empty hand to collect, or a stick to cancel. Sneak-use a clock for earned incubation growth, a glass bottle for water economy. Break and replace to move the one saved core.
